item.title: Belvedere is Transitioning to a .gov Domain
item.description: The City of Belvedere is excited to announce the transition to a .gov domain effective October 1, 2026. This will change the web address from www.cityofbelvedere.org to www.cityofbelvedere.gov. The .gov domain is reserved exclusively for verified U.S. government entities, making this switch a smart step forward in strengthening cybersecurity.
